Recall keeps a local encrypted index on every device. The relay only ever sees opaque envelope JSON: a version, a base64 IV, and base64 ciphertext with the GCM tag appended. There is no title, no URL, no OCR text and no thumbnail in D1 or R2 metadata. Search runs against the local SQLite FTS5 index with BM25 ranking, a 180-day recency half-life, synonym expansion loaded from a runtime-editable file, and a fuzzy LIKE fallback that guarantees the UI never shows a blank screen. Old items sync in when the device reconnects; recent items are searchable with no network at all.
